Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a task force to study the interstate compact on educational opportunity for military children.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to an interstate compact on educational opportunityfor military children; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The governor shall appoint a task forceto study the interstate compact on educational opportunity for militarychildren and make recommendations to the legislature by December 1,2008, on whether it is in the state's interest to adopt the compact. (2) The task force shall consist of the following members: (a) The attorney general or his designee; (b) The superintendent of public instruction or her designee; (c) A representative from each educational service district; (d) A representative from the state board of education; and (e) A superintendent from a school district with a highconcentration of military children. (3) Staff support for the task force shall be provided by theoffice of the superintendent of public instruction.
